claim: Step 36 builds five adversarial F24 competitors with their defining structures present.
The HiddenUpstreamRole competitor is defeated because hidden lambda is inadmissible and exposed lambda collapses to L.
The CoarsenedRole competitor is defeated because d3-from-qQM has positive held-out residual even for polynomial degrees 1-4.
The d2 coarsening control passes at numerical zero so the coarsening screen is not rigged to fail.
The BudgetedRole competitor is defeated because it retains a positive cutoff residual while L has exact endpoint residual 0.
The ScopedRole competitor is defeated because it resolves only a proper subcarrier and fails on the full carrier.
The MemoryLayer competitor is defeated because hidden history is inadmissible and exposed history collapses to L.
L remains the positive anchor and equivalent L prime is not rejected by the screen.
Step 36 strengthens type-uniqueness by defeat rather than absence.
The defeat is bounded to full exact reconciliation types in G* and does not declare competitor methods universally invalid.
